name: Overlay only
summary: Never inject, hook, read memory, or capture screen of the game

name: Low RAM & CPU
summary: Idle overlay target <= 20 MB; zero CPU render loop when static

name: One source of truth
summary: One core library owns all state/logic via command bus; UI/MCP are thin clients

name: Human/agent parity
summary: All UI capabilities exist as commands and MCP tools

name: Schema-driven
summary: Single declaration of properties generates UI controls, tooltips, validation, and MCP schemas

name: Pixel accuracy
summary: Provably correct screen center across all resolutions, DPIs, and stretch modes

name: Clean documented code
summary: Strict type safety, safe Win32 wrappers, no unwrap in production, comprehensive docs

name: Repository source of truth
summary: Git repo files are canonical project memory; external MCP DBs are read-only mirrors
